start_here: Say to your AI: "Read the records of the zone example.com on Hetzner." It runs tool:read-hetzner-dns-rrsets with the zone name.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads or changes your Hetzner DNS zones.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI what to do, with the zone name and the record values.
2. The AI calls tools:run with the tool and its input.
3. Read the answer; a change is real, so check it with tool:read-hetzner-dns-rrsets.

worked_examples.title: Read a Hetzner DNS zone's records
worked_examples.ask: Read the records of the zone example.com on Hetzner.
worked_examples.given: Reads tools/hetzner-dns/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json: GET https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1/zones/{zone}/rrsets with the vault key hetzner-api-token as a bearer header, to api.hetzner.cloud only.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answers each record set with its name, type, TTL and values, for example @ A 60 with 203.0.113.10.
